name.en: Static grey radiative transfer,scattering and linear exchange

note.ja: 正規化した角度平均を使います。物質交換は1997輸送例と周期Fourier比較で進めます。1997の光学座標では係数1、物理座標の比較ではκを輻射・物質の両交換項に掛けます。
note.en: Use a normalized angular mean. Material exchange is evolved in the1997 transport example and periodic Fourier controls. The1997 optical coordinates give a unit exchange coefficient; physical-coordinate controls multiply both exchange terms by kappa.

equation_note.ja: 光学厚さ.5/3、単一散乱albedo.5/.9の4入力。左の等方入射I1、右入射0。64/128/256セル、32角と独立64角probe。
equation_note.en: Four fixed inputs L=.5/3,albedo=.5/.9;unit left incoming radiance,right vacuum incoming.64/128/256cells at32signed angles and a separate64angle probe.

note.en: Solve genuinely coupled signed-angle steady transport and compare R/T/A with an independent continuum-angle Fredholm reference.

title.ja: 等方散乱平板：連続角Fredholm流束参照
title.en: Isotropically scattering slab: continuous-angle Fredholm flux reference

references.formula: J(x)=.5*E2(x)+omega/2*integral_0^L E1(|x-y|)J(y)dy; R=2omega*integral J E2(x)dx; T=2E3(L)+2omega*integral J E2(L-x)dx; A=4(1-omega)*integral J dx.

assumptions.ja: 平行平板の定常な光学厚さ座標を用い、左の入射輻射輝度は1、右の入射は真空、等方散乱の単一散乱アルベドを固定します。入射半球流束はπ、符号付き角度の平均はJ=(1/2)∫I dμです。
assumptions.en: Plane-parallel steady optical-depth slab, unit incoming radiance on the left,vacuum incoming on the right,isotropic single-scattering albedo. Incoming hemispherical flux pi; signed-angle J=.5*integral I.

note.ja: 有限の4平板に限定。MC、一般角度phase関数、DISORT再現、普遍的次数や厳密連続体誤差境界は認証しません。
note.en: Limited to fourfixedisotropic slabs;noMC,generalphase-function/DISORT reproduction,universalorder or rigorouscontinuumerrorbound.

reference_note.ja: 独立参照78項目はmain前に合格。主18計算では収支・正値・残差と、別々の空間・角度差、純吸収・保存散乱controlを判定します。
reference_note.en: Independent reference78checks passed before main.18primary/control solves test budget,positivity,residuals,separate space/angle changes,pure absorption and conservative scattering.

name.ja: 輻射輸送・モーメント法

method_note.ja: 保存的風上FVの全方向source結合を離散sweep応答で解きます。半球ごとの正重みGaussにより入射流束πを正規化し、吸収は体積sourceから独立積算します。
method_note.en: Conservative upwind FV with the full discrete angular source coupling solved by sweep-response elimination. Positive hemisphere Gauss weights normalize incoming fluxpi;absorption is independently accumulated from the volume source.
